rules: This cadence is Konoha institutional procedure for the campaign, not a forced future-canon date or outcome.
Opening a cycle identifies exact Genin who already have persisted promotion eligibility; it never invents eligibility.
Opening the cycle does not silently choose examination results or promotions for named shinobi.
Any later exact promotion must pass the evidence-gated career reducer and can advance only one rank.
Every exact rank change synchronizes conserved aggregate village rank counts.
